sources.supports: Fast R-CNN uses externally generated proposals and shared convolutional feature computation.
Faster R-CNN introduces a learned RPN sharing full-image convolutional features.
Original YOLO center-cell responsibility, mixed coordinate normalization, one conditional class vector per cell, class-score multiplication, 24-convolution/two-dense architecture.
Ultralytics YOLOv8 was released in January 2023, uses an anchor-free split head, and has multiple size/task variants.
Nonstreaming prediction returns per-input Results; conf and iou have different roles; class-agnostic NMS, local source paths, saving and rectangle padding are distinct settings.
Boxes geometry, confidence and class IDs are separate; xywh uses center coordinates and pixel widths/heights.
The standard Detect module receives P3/8, P4/16 and P5/32. This matches the actual independently executed head, not a claim that the lecture schematic shows four heads.
Conv2d uses NCHW conventions, cross-correlation and all input planes at groups=1. Installed-version behavior was also executed.
Normalization plus learned affine scale/offset is not hard interval clipping; training and evaluation statistics can differ.

webLimitation: Unversioned PyTorch documentation URLs returned redirect placeholders; the official versioned 2.9 API documents were readable. No browser denial or bypass occurred.
